bugs.summary: Admin report sends order count and revenue in the body of the login redirect
bugs.environment: Local copy of mini-shop (fixture), PHP 7.2 + Apache, MariaDB 10.4, Chromium (Playwright 1.65.0)
steps: Reset the database to the seed
Without logging in, request admin/report.php without following redirects
bugs.expected: HTTP 302 to ../login.php with an empty body
bugs.actual: HTTP 302 to ../login.php whose body contains "Orders: 1 Revenue: 12"
bugs.root_cause: admin/report.php:5 header("Location: ../login.php") is not followed by exit, so the page keeps running
evidence: test: report sends no data without a session @TC-ADM-001 F-001
